d:
Dahi bhalle bina phraee, bina stim! Appe mold mein andar se spongy, bahar se crispy
appe mold men bina phraee dahi bhalle
barph ke kyub se dal pisne ki trik
kon se barabar bhalle + kishmish
ghar par speshal chat masala
Comment karen — bhalle men kishmish ya kaju-chiraunji?
Quick Recipe: dal 4 ghante bhigoiye, ice cube ke saath peesiye, 4-5 minute phentiye, meetha soda-namak-jeera milaiye. Appe mold mein cone se bhariye, kishmish rakhiye, dhak kar pakaiye; gunguna hing-namak paani mein bhigoiye.
